title: Laying a table for six without buying anything
excerpt: A runner, something green down the middle, and plates that do not match. A table that looks cared for, from what is in the cupboard.
content:
A table looks cared for when one thing runs down the middle of it. A cloth runner will do, or a row of whatever is green in the garden.

What goes on it

  • A runner, or a folded tablecloth
  • Greenery, laid flat rather than in a vase
  • Plates of two sizes, which need not match

Nobody remembers the plates. They remember that someone thought about the table.

What to leave off

Tall flowers, which people cannot see over, and anything that has to be explained.
